description: Low-maintenance setup: few PRs, automerge when CI is green, majors wait for a human. packageList/ is a crawler-generated aggregate of untrusted third-party packages and must never be touched by Renovate.

packageRules.description: One grouped PR for all non-major npm updates, merged automatically when CI passes.
One grouped PR for all GitHub Actions updates (including majors, which are usually safe), merged automatically when CI passes.
Major npm updates need approval on the Dependency Dashboard, so they don't open PRs on their own.
